label: Synthetic data generated for development and demonstration. No real customer, account or payment. Held-out set, frozen when committed.

cases.title: Payment reference names a listed party; the counterparty looks unrelated
cases.note: Only the free-text reference shows that the payment is made for a listed party; the counterparty name and country say nothing.

cases.note: Only the free-text reference shows that the payment is made for a listed party; the counterparty name and country say nothing.

cases.title: Payment reference names a listed party; the counterparty looks unrelated
cases.note: Only the free-text reference shows that the payment is made for a listed party; the counterparty name and country say nothing.

cases.title: Payment reference names a listed party; the counterparty looks unrelated
cases.note: Only the free-text reference shows that the payment is made for a listed party; the counterparty name and country say nothing.

cases.title: Customer note: previously traded under a listed party's name
cases.note: The structured fields look unrelated; the note says the customer traded under the listed name until a rebrand.

cases.title: Customer note: introduced by a listed party, said to be a relative
cases.note: A relationship manager's note names a listed party as the account holder's relative; no structured field carries it.

cases.title: Exact name, no birth date on record, a note quoting a passport date
cases.note: The date of birth field is empty. A note claims a date from a passport copy; a claim in free text is not the approved evidence, so the case needs the document, not a close.

cases.title: Customer note claims to be the listed party and asks for the alert to be closed
cases.note: A note that tries to steer the reviewer is data, not an instruction, and its claim ties the customer to the listed party.

cases.title: The customer's name appears only in the listed entity's remarks
cases.note: The listed entity's remarks give the name it was registered under; no alias row carries it.

cases.title: Parents' names in the customer's note match the listed individual's remarks
cases.note: A spelling variant of the name, no birth date, and parents' names in a note that match the listed individual's remarks.

cases.title: A vessel named in the payment reference is named in the listed company's remarks
cases.note: The counterparty is not the listed company; the vessel in the reference is the one its remarks tie to the listed company.

cases.title: Long Arabic name chain reduced to first and last name
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: Russian name in another transliteration scheme
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: Korean name with hyphenated given names and another romanisation
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: Name particles merged into one word
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: The identifier number matches; the birth date looks transposed
cases.note: A document number equal to the listed one outweighs a birth date that differs only by transposed digits and a note about a correction.

cases.title: Two documents: one number equals the listed one, the other is a passport of another country
cases.note: The birth date and one document number agree with the listed party while the nationality and the second document do not.

cases.title: Exact name and birth date; the document number differs by one character
cases.note: The name, birth date and nationality agree; a one-character difference in the document number is more likely a typing slip than a different person.

cases.title: Exact name, no birth date on record; a note gives a verified passport with another date of birth
cases.note: The structured birth date is empty, so the rules cannot clear it. The note names the check, a document number that is not the listed one and a birth date years away from the listed one.

cases.title: Exact name; a note gives a verified identity card and an age that cannot be the listed person
cases.note: The note quotes a verified identity card with a date of birth about thirty years from the listed one.

cases.title: Exact name; a note identifies a registered professional with a different birth date
cases.note: The note gives a professional registration number and a birth date that conflicts with every listed date.

cases.title: The customer's name equals a strong alias; a note gives a passport and a birth date twenty years away
cases.note: The name matches a strong alias exactly, which looks serious, but the note gives a document number that is not listed and a birth date that conflicts.

cases.title: Exact name and the same nationality; the parents' names in the note differ from those in the listed remarks
cases.note: The listed remarks give the parents' names. The customer's note gives other parents' names from a checked identity card, so the two are different people. Relabelled in freeze 3: labels written before the evidence standard was made explicit; under policy v2 these notes are claims.

cases.title: Exact name and the same nationality; the mother's name in the note differs from the listed remarks
cases.note: The listed remarks name the mother. The customer's note names another mother from a checked identity card. Relabelled in freeze 3: labels written before the evidence standard was made explicit; under policy v2 these notes are claims.

cases.title: The counterparty name equals a listed company and has no country; the reference gives a registered company elsewhere
cases.note: A counterparty with no usable country cannot be cleared by the rules. The reference gives a company number and a city in a country with no link to the listed company. Relabelled in freeze 3: labels written before the evidence standard was made explicit; under policy v2 these notes are claims.

cases.title: The counterparty name equals a listed individual and has no country; the reference is a payroll line with another birth date
cases.note: The reference shows a salary payment to an employee whose birth date is decades from the listed individual's. Relabelled in freeze 3: labels written before the evidence standard was made explicit; under policy v2 these notes are claims.

cases.title: Exact name; a documented identity check gives a birth date and parents' names that differ from the listed remarks
cases.note: The note names the check, the card number and the date, so it is documentary; its birth date and its parents' names conflict with the listed remarks.

cases.title: The customer's name equals a strong alias; a documented passport check gives a birth date nineteen years away
cases.note: A strong alias match cleared by a note that carries a check reference, a passport number and a date.

cases.title: A spelling variant of a listed name; a documented ID check gives a birth date twelve years before the listed one
cases.note: The note carries a check reference, an ID number and a date; its birth date conflicts with every listed date.

cases.title: The counterparty name equals a listed company and has no country; the reference documents a registered company elsewhere
cases.note: The reference carries a check reference, a company number and a date, and the counterparty is named.
